sara: Quick kudos to Tony and Indra for untangling the auth flakiness during the partner demo. You two made it look easy. :sparkles:
tony: shoutout to Indra for chasing the token refresh edge case. i patched the client in 10m thanks to her repro steps. :rocket:
indra: team effort. harry helped validate across regions which caught a timezone mismatch. :earth_asia:
harry: happy to help. adding a tiny test to the e2e suite now so we don't see it again.
sara: can someone drop a short note in #ops-highlights? i'd love to mention this in the weekly recap.
tony: i'll write a 1-liner and nominate Indra for the Ripple award. also who wants bagels tomorrow? :bagel:
indra: i'll take a blueberry muffin. remote folks, i'll send a virtual coffee voucher too. :coffee:
ops-bot: Incident: auth-flaky-demo resolved at 11:22 by @tony and @indra. Postmortem not required. :white_check_mark:
sara: thanks everyone. micro-rescues keep product demos on track  big appreciation vibes. :raised_hands:
